title: Summer Pockets: Natsu no Takaramono

synopsis: Takahara Hairi never expected summer to feel like a dream. titleNative: 悪役貴族が開き直って破滅フラグを“実力”で叩き折っていたら、いつの間にかヒロイン達から英雄視されるようになった件
synonyms: I Broke Dead End Flag and I Became a Hero
When the Villainous Noble Embraced His Role and Became a Hero
When the Villainous Noble Embraced His Role and Broke the Doom Flags with "Power," He Unexpectedly Became a Hero to the Heroines
synopsis: I found myself reincarnated as the villain in a game called “Kaleido Lily Academy.” The villain in question—Ix Vandille, the heir of the Count’s family—was a typical scumbag. Hated by many, he was condemned and killed in every scenario set in the academy. At this rate, I would die as soon as I entered the academy. However, my bad reputation knew no bounds, and it was too late to reform myself now. Therefore… “That’s it! If I become stronger than the protagonists and show them my power, they won’t dare to oppose me…!” To avoid being killed by the protagonists, I must become stronger than them. If I display my power, they won’t think of making a move against me. And if they do, I will just defeat them. With this resolve, Ix spent the three years before the academy began training desperately. “…Master, your strength is unmatched by anyone your age now.” “Hahaha! This is all due to my perseverance!” Ix became stronger than the protagonists. And soon, he began to show his strength to the protagonists, the heroine princess, noble daughters, and saintesses… but for some reason, he started being regarded as a hero.
chapterSourceTitle: Akuyaku Kizoku ga Hirakinaotte Hametsu Flag wo "Jitsuryoku" de Tatakiotteitara, Itsunomanika Heroine-tachi kara Eiyuushi Sareru you ni natta Ken

title: Kimi wa "Suki" no Daimeishi
synopsis: 1. Kimi wa "Suki" no Daimeishi I didn't think you'd still remember me once you'd gained fame. When you're supposed to pick me up, you don't even think to come. That's why, when there's someone who even slightly resembles you... Ten years ago, you left me to become a kabuki actor. But I still remember the promise from that day... You have become famous and are called "the most beautiful high school student in Japan". I'm living in a different world from you. That's why you won't even think to meet me once again...? 2. Hetakuso Kata Omoi (Hopeless Unrequited Love) All Yuri wants to do is talk to her crush in her art club, Yano-kun, yet she's able to do anything but. Getting an idea, she asks Yano's best friend, Kimidzuka, for some tips on how to make her ideal for Yano. Though reluctant, Kimi-kun helps out... 3. Eien ni Nemure (Eternal Sleep) Jin's just a lowly pirate with an incredibly handsome face and loves playing with women, but this annoying female brat, who he was going to sell as a slave with the rest of them, somehow feels different from everyone else.

Riding the unprecedented occult boom, Inubosaki, an editor of a third-rate occult magazine, is covering strange incidents with his cameraman Asama, who is also psychic. As Asama's psychic powers draw them together, the two encounter a number of terrifying and bizarre phenomena. Meanwhile, in the present day, 2023, an elderly Asama is visited by someone claiming to be Inubosaki's nephew. This is the start of a bizarre tale about forbidden memories that must not be unveiled.
